owner: parent; delegated modules remain untrusted until integration and independent review
purpose: Implement missing X1-X7 parent consumer, not a scheduler, five-part release transaction or scientific solver

interface.schema: audit_schema(plan_bytes:bytes,item:str,files:dict[str,bytes],prefix:list[dict],original_dm21:bytes,deadline_check:callable)->list[str]; returns [] or [X5 RESULT_SCHEMA]; pinned validator implementation loaded from approved bytes only by explicit function call; no file writes/process calls
interface.schema_prefix: Ordered records exactly matching all preceding plan items, each {item,files,audit_bytes}. files maps declared basename to immutable bytes; audit_bytes is canonical ext-search-job-audit-v1. Parent separately provenance-binds each receipt/audit; schema does not make syntax equal authority. Current DATA uses prefix=[]; search/gate must validate dependencies and current result. Calibration items are outside the twenty-job plan and must be rejected.
interface.read_bytes: Parent-owned callable path, cap -> bytes from descriptor-anchored normalized absolute path, regular one-link NONBLOCK|NOFOLLOW leaf and all NOFOLLOW parents, cap+1 bounded read, post-read identity/size/link and final close/elapsed checks. Tests may use explicitly labelled immutable snapshot callback; never represent it as kernel evidence.
expectation_fields: date_start and date_end exact parent-bound record objects
observed_fields: actual_exit exact int (negative signal permitted but never matches intended exit)
actual_artifact_names list[str] (actual directory census from parent)
capture_rules: Strict scalar/container type equality: bool never int; all counts nonnegative exact ints; hashes lowercase64hex. Malformed records fail closed, accumulate independent causes without exceptions becoming success.
X1 actual_exit must exactly equal expected_exit.

X2/X3 distinguish missing from present incomplete; present files re-read at declared path, exact bytes/hash/count equality, eof true, overflow false, error null. stdout must equal actual result.json bytes, which X5 independently validates as a single canonical line; stderr must be empty. Empty complete capture is not missing capture.

X4 exact artifact-name set, normalized bound paths under job_dir, declared actual bytes/hash/nlink==1/positive ino; parent reader retains actual identity evidence. No undeclared files; missing result.json fails X4 and cannot satisfy X2.
X6 exact reaped/group_empty/census_complete true, unresolved=[] and signals=[]; this consumes parent observations, does not establish OS-endedness or fulfill release part4 itself.

X7 exact receipt path/hash binding to parent expectation and actual bytes; exact item/mode/plan/argv/GO/source/input/date bindings. Rehash pinned source/input files through reader. Nonempty parent-bound date records are provenance, not inferred or fabricated fresh /bin/date.
schema_rules: Reuse existing pinned ext4_gate validation algorithms and exact schemas rather than second scientific convention. It is acceptable to execute verified module definitions with __name__ not __main__ only inside the explicit validator entry, never at import; forbidden to call gate.main or run code during authoring.

A snapshot-bound original-DM21 reader replacing gate anchored_read_bytes may serve ONLY its exact plan.dm21_path, verify original bytes digest against plan, reject every other path. This is explicitly recorded offline snapshot evaluation, not a real-path reader smoke.

Validate current/prefix data maker, exact controls, search metadata/solutions/chunks/peer equality and previous gate result schemas using current pinned plan; a final G-CONTROLS result requires qualified true, earlier gates false; target_claim UNEVALUATED. Require result program_sha256 equals actual pinned program, not just syntactic hex.
Never turn validation of controls or fixture acceptance into six-MOLS39/CFR21 scientific acceptance.

parent_integration: Parent supplies anchored readers and from-disk expectation/observation adapters, pins every immutable input, calls both modules, deduplicates causes in X1..X7 order, and writes only exclusive decision evidence. A PASS decision never automatically writes a canonical audit, releases reservations or admits next job. Canonical audit/release require full separate five-part parent transaction. Fixtures and negatives can never write plan audit directory.
required_after_source_review: One separately admitted finite behavioral run exercising missing/partial stdout, missing/partial stderr, actual exits5/94/120, baseline positive, bool/type errors, provenance and artifact mismatches. Genuine N1 C1-C4 remain separately admitted and must all reject. No execution now.
write_scope: Only new versioned files in RUN/control and RUN/review owned as assigned, mode x. No /tmp, old-file edits, builds/tests/imports/compile or nested subagents. Metadata checks allowed. All code remains untested/source-only until parent qualification.
